overall_reason: The job is reading what a research company stands for and what it just shipped: a mission statement, a featured-research showcase, the three latest model releases and four policy documents follow that job, and no section is a stock feature, steps or CTA band.

score.reason: T-SQUINT and T-SCREEN-BY-SCREEN pass on every tile and T-STOCK-ORDER finds no stock run, but T-HEADINGS-READ finds only one section heading ("Learn more") and T-JUDGE-TILE finds empty bands inside the release cards.

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json has one h1 (the mission statement at y=132) and one h2, "Learn more", set at 13px at y=1707. The featured-research showcase and the three release cards have no section heading at all; the release cards sit under no label.
findings.before: h1 statement, then one 13px h2 "Learn more".
findings.after: Give the release group and the showcase a short heading that names what they are (for example "Latest models" and "Featured research"), and replace "Learn more" with a head that names the four documents as commitments.
findings.why: A reader scanning headings sees the mission and then "Learn more"; the outline does not say that the page holds new models and safety commitments.

findings.evidence: Each card's description ends near y=445 in the tile and the "Model Details" row starts at y=550, leaving a band of about 100px of empty card inside each of the three 440px-tall cards.
findings.before: Equal-height cards with a fixed gap between a three-line description and the link rows.
findings.after: Let the link rows follow the description, or use the space for one fact per model [DATA NEEDED: one benchmark or price line per model].
findings.why: The empty band is the largest area inside each card, so under the squint the cards read as empty boxes with a footer.

findings.evidence: The footer accordion starts at x=507 while every section above starts at x=80; the left 427px of the footer holds nothing until the copyright line at the bottom of tile 1440-03.
findings.before: Footer content on a 507px start line under a page that starts at 80px.
findings.after: Keep the offset only if it repeats a column of the page grid; otherwise put the brand mark or the mission text in the empty left column.
findings.why: The footer opens a new edge that no section above uses, so the dark block reads as a separate page.

strengths: The first screen has one focal point: the mission statement in a bold-to-serif run across the full width, then a single showcase image under it.
The order follows the job: mission, featured research, latest releases with model details and system cards, then the policy documents. No section would sit unchanged on another company's home page.
Every block starts on the 80px edge at 1440 until the footer, and the squint shows clear heavy and light rhythm: statement, image, three cards, four images.
At 375 the order is kept, and the four document cards become a carousel with a 01 / 04 counter instead of a long stack.
not_investigated: T-FIVE-SECOND primary action: a corporate home page with no single action; the "Try Claude" menu in the header is the only action and its rect was not checked against the fold.
The h1 length (34 words, h1_words) and 121 words on screen 2 (words_per_screen) are sweep findings and are not repeated.
One script chunk was blocked during capture (manifest network); the showcase carousel may not show its full behaviour. Cookie banner was dismissed by page prep.
